lines.t: I hear a whisper in the quiet space
A persistent nudge I try to erase How many times has it pressed on my heart?
But I stand on the edge, afraid to start Safe in the shadows, choosing to wait
Lingering right outside the gate
Saying not yet, saying someday soon
Chasing the sun while ignoring the moon
Putting off what I was born to do
While the quiet voice keeps calling through
No more waiting for the perfect day
I'm stepping out, I am on my way
With a joyful heart and a steady stride
Leaving the doubt and the fear behind
You are my shield, you are my guide
I'm walking the path with nowhere to hide
I used to look at the road ahead
Counting the miles with a sense of dread
Asking how far before I would move
Demanding a sign, looking for proof
But a heavy heart makes a weary soul
This time to surrender and yield control
No more waiting for the perfect day
I'm stepping out, I am on my way
With a joyful heart and a steady stride
Leaving the doubt and the fear behind
You are my shield, you are my guide
I'm walking the path with nowhere to hide
You provide the strength for every mile
Turning the duty into a smile
From the very first breath to the final hour
Your presence is peace
Your promise is power
Never alone, never forsaken
A foundation that cannot be shaken
No more waiting for the perfect day
I'm stepping out, I am on my way
With a joyful heart and a steady stride
Leaving the doubt and the fear behind
You are my shield, you are my guide
I'm walking the path with nowhere to hide
Here I am, no more delay
Here I am, leading the way
Walking the path with unwavering trust
